subject: Cannot install seewave on linux mint

messages.author: dcc41d223275a76a
messages.subject: Cannot install seewave on linux mint
parts:
High guys.
 I tried to install seewave on linux mint, but it did not finnish the job.
The error message:

"Compilation failed"

I did what the installation guid on the seewave homepage told me. Several times. But I still did not succeed in installing the programm. This is essential for my work, which is why I would be glad if anyone encountered a similar problem.
FT

messages.author: 875f7ee6903447f7
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Cannot install seewave on linux mint
parts:
Hello

open the bash and do

:~$ sudo R
:~$ enter password:

once you are in R as root, do:

> install.packages("seewave", dependencies =TRUE,
repos=your_favorite_cran_repo)

and let's see what's the output.

Best Wishes,
Pietro Coretto

messages.author: 44c03a0165efd08f
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Re: Cannot install seewave on linux mint
parts: To me it looks like you're missing the sndfile.h dependency:
>> stft.c:3:61: fatal error: sndfile.h: No such file or directory

I think I had a similar problem and solved it by adding the libraries that contain that file (for Ubuntu 12.04 it was libsndfile1). I assume there's an equivalent for Linux Mint.

Hope this helps,

Steffi

Yes, true, actually you also need to install the libsndfile1-dev package (for Ubuntu).
Let us know if you could solve the problem, I will the mention it on the seewave webpage for other Mint users.
Jerome
